BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.

5. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

6. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

7. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

12. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wall Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

2. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A — CPU

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

10. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. C — Information and Communication Technology

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Building Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
